title: A City Echoing with Joyful Screams

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the parade. 
Many customers had come to Halloween Park. 
What they saw were not scary ghosts... but.
text_block_list.orig_text:
パレードの当日。
ハロウィンパークにはたくさんのお客がやってきていた。
彼らが目にするのは恐ろしいお化け……ではなく。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Welcome to our town~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようこそ、
オイラたちの町へ～♪

text_block_list.name: ビクター
text_block_list.text:
怖いよ～
びっくりするよ～♪
でも
とっても楽しいよ～♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖いよ～
びっくりするよ～♪
でも
とっても楽しいよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I'll guide you to a fun world~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 楽しい世界へ案内するッスよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You're such a cute little ghost!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは！　
ずいぶんかわいらしいお化けさんね！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text:
You think I'm cute, huh?! 
But actually, we are really scary, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かわいいだと！
オレサマたちは
本当は怖いんだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text:
But thank you! 
If you come to the haunted house,
I'll give you a special service!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもあんがとな！
お化け屋敷に来てくれたら
サービスするぜ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Foolish humans! 
You shall bow before me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハハハ！　
愚かな人間どもよ！
我が前にひれ伏すがいい！

text_block_list.name: エディ
text_block_list.text:
えーと、
あれだ！
たくさん楽しい悲鳴をあげるがいい！
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと、
あれだ！
たくさん楽しい悲鳴をあげるがいい！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey Mom~ I want that floating stuffed animal! 
I wonder where they sell it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇママ～
あの浮かんでるぬいぐるみ欲しい！
どこに売ってるのかな。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see. Shall we look for a souvenir shop later?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうねぇ。
あとでお土産屋さん探してみましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Plush toy!? I'm not a plush toy, you know!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみ！？　
オレはぬいぐるみじゃないぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? 
Instead of just watching from there, let's walk together. 
I'll light the way for you. Come on, hold my hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？
そんなところで見てないで、
一緒に歩こう。
ボクが照らしてあげるから。
ほら、
手を繋いで。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……うん。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're such a brave kid for not being scared of me. Let's go on an adventure together on Halloween night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフッ、
ボクを怖がらないなんて
キミは強い子だね。
一緒にハロウィンの夜を冒険しよう！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Those kids seem to be doing quite well, don't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子たち、
ずいぶんとうまくやっているみたいじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see. 
I was worried that you might mess something up, 
but you've truly become impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
何かやらかすんじゃないかと心配してましたけど、
本当に立派になりました。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi and the children she raised, along with the people wearing the costumes they made, are walking. Just being able to witness this sight, this year's Halloween was truly wonderful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギが育てた子たちと、
作った衣装を着た人たちが歩いてる。
この光景を見られただけでも、
今年のハロウィンは
本当によかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I am truly overjoyed to be able to walk together with Miss Rei! If only every day could be Halloween! No, let's make it Halloween!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もレイ様と一緒に歩けるなんて、
本っ当に超幸せです！
毎日がハロウィンならいいのに！　
いえ、
ハロウィンにしましょう！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Well, that's a little... Oh, I see. After Halloween is over, those kids will return to the spirit world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはちょっと……
あ、
でもそうか。
ハロウィンが終わったら
あの子たちも霊界に帰ってしまうんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
That is... No, no, no! Now is not the time to be gloomy! 
I must stroll through the town with a beaming smile!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
いや、
いやいや！
今は湿っぽくなってるときじゃないですよ！
満面の笑みで町を練り歩かないと！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Tsumugi... Yes, that's right. 
Those kids are doing their best. We can't slack off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギ……
うん、
そうだね。
あの子たちが頑張ってるんだ。
手は抜けないね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! 
We must always show them that we are leading the way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですよ！
私たちは
常にあの子たちの先を歩いてみせないと！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
At the haunted house that entertained many customers, 
the last business day of the year has arrived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさんのお客さんを楽しませたお化け屋敷にも、
今年最後の営業日がやって来た。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: It's all over now...
text_block_list.orig_text: 終わっちゃいましたね……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose...
text_block_list.orig_text: そうッスね……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text: うん……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi! I've finished the last bit of cleaning up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃ～ん！　
最後の片づけ終わったよ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I've come back all nice and clean~
text_block_list.orig_text: きれいにしてきた～

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I didn't slack off either, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text: オレもサボらずやったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Don't lie! You just let Victor do it for a little while, didn't you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘘つけ！　
おまえちょっとビクターにやらせてただろ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't say that!
You'll get scolded by Tsumugi, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
おまえそれ言うなよ！
ツムギちゃんに怒られ、
る、
だろう？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃん……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! Y-Yes, that's right!
Skipping work is not allowed! Eddie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！　
そ、
そうですね！
サボるのはダメですよ！　
エディさん！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This must be the last time Tsumugi scolds me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ツムギちゃんに怒られるのも
これが最後かぁ……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: This isn't the end! Because there's always next year!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後じゃないよ！　
また来年があるからね！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's make an even more awesome haunted house next year! And let's bring other ghosts too!
Let's make even more people laugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな！　
来年はもっとすげぇお化け屋敷やろうぜ！
他のお化けも連れてきてさ！
もっとたくさんの人たちを
笑わせてやろうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Do I not have to scare you anymore?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう
怖がらせなくていいんスか？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
We absolutely love entertaining people, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん！　
ボクたちは楽しませることが大好きだから！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tsumugi, we were able to grow! 
We were able to... grow, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃんのおかげで
ボクたちは成長できたんだよ！
成長……
できたよね？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You guys still have a long way to go... is what I want to say, but when I saw the faces of the people who came out of the haunted house, I can't say such things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちなんかまだまだ……
って言いたいところですけど、
お化け屋敷から出た人たちの顔を見たら、
そんなこと言えませんね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Guests were enjoying themselves enough. 
Did you all have fun too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客さんは十分楽しんでくれていました。
あなたたちも楽しかったですか？

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: That is my answer.
text_block_list.orig_text: それが私の答えです。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: This is praise from Tsumugi.
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギからの誉め言葉だよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Probably the highest level, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たぶん最上級の、
ッスよね？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Is that so?
text_block_list.orig_text: そうなの？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Enough already! Both of you, please stop saying unnecessary things! 
If you're satisfied with this, you'll get bored next year, you know! 
Don't let your guard down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！　
二人とも余計なこと言わないでください！
これで満足してたら
来年は飽きられちゃいますからね！
油断しちゃダメです！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: There, I'll come back with a proper power-up!
text_block_list.orig_text: そこはきちんとパワーアップしてくるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I wonder if we'll be okay on our own?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オイラたちだけで
大丈夫かなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: There, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこは、
ほら……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: When you're in trouble, ask Tsumugi for help, okay!
text_block_list.orig_text: 困ったときはツムギちゃんにお願いするね！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I don't want to
text_block_list.orig_text: いやです。

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh!

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Are you really eager to help out?
text_block_list.orig_text: ほんとは手伝う気満々ッスよね？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: If not, we won't have to worry about next year, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でないと
来年の心配なんかしないよね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Ha... If you say something like that, Miss Rei, these children might start slacking off, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
そんなこと言ったら
この子たちがサボっちゃうかもしれないじゃないですか。

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Tsumugi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
ツムギちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
We'll do our best! 
To respond to Tsugumi's feelings, 
We'll grow even more next year and come to see you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクたちがんばる！
ツムギちゃんの想いに応えられるよう、
来年はもっと成長して会いに来るね！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I'll wait without expecting anything.
text_block_list.orig_text: 期待せずに待ってます。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're not obedient until the end, huh~
text_block_list.orig_text: 最後まで素直じゃないッスね～

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but we know that Tsumugi is kind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
でもボクたちは
ツムギちゃんが優しいの知ってるから。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am a kind person. Please be grateful for a long time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
私は優しいんです。
末長く感謝してください。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
So, is it really okay for me to see you off here? 
I could accompany you until the very end...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
本当にここで見送りでいいのかい？
最後までついていってもいいのに……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because saying goodbye is becoming harder...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
お別れがつらくなっちゃうから……

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text:
And Miss Rei, you're not good with graves, right? 
The entrance to the spirit world is a grave, you know?
Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにレイさま
お墓苦手だろ？
霊界の入り口は
お墓だぜ？　
大丈夫か？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm fine with that much for your sake. 
But, yeah. I wonder if the grave after you're gone will be lonely and painful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
キミたちのためなら
それくらい平気だよ。
でも、
そうだね。
キミたちがいなくなった後のお墓は
さみしくてつらいかな……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! One of use have been to the spirit world before,
Kishi-san. He might come to see if you guys are slacking off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうですね！
だいたいこっちには
霊界に行ったことのある騎士さんが居るんです。
あなたたちがだらけてないか見に行くかもしれませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: There aren't many lively places like this around here, but at that time, we will show you around happily!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちみたいに
にぎやかなところはあんまりないけど、
そのときはボクたちが
楽しく案内してみせるよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm looking forward to it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
楽しみに……
してますね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Well then, we're going to go now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
ボクたち
もう行くね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I hope you stay well.
text_block_list.orig_text: 元気でね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If you don't come, I'll transform and appear, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text: 来なかったら化けてでるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Let us meet again.
text_block_list.orig_text: また会いましょう。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: I will definitely come to see you! Well then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対会いに来るよ！　
それじゃあ……

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text: See you later~!
text_block_list.orig_text: またね～！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, once again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
また……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You've gone and left, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text: 行っちゃったッスね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm finally done and feeling relieved. 
Goodness, this year's Halloween was quite hectic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
ようやく終わってせいせいしますよ。
まったく、
今年のハロウィンは
いろいろ大忙しでした。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi...
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギさん……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right.
Next time,
I have to make sure I don't get laughed at by those kids.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうですね。
次に会うとき、
あの子たちに笑われないようにしないと。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Don't you think you should just admit that you recognize Matthew and the others? It would be better if you just say it clearly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりマシューさんたちのこと認めてるんじゃないッスか。
分かりやすく言ってあげればいいのに。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I wonder if not conveying it is the whip of love.
text_block_list.orig_text:
伝えないのは愛のムチ、
なんじゃないかな。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Please don't misunderstand! It's not love! However... I do acknowledge their unwavering attitude towards hard work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勘違いしないでください！　
愛なんてありません！
ただ……
ひたむきに努力する姿勢だけは認めてますけどね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Are these the children that Tsumugi acknowledges...?
I can't afford to lose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギが認める子たちか……
負けていられないな。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Miss Rei... What did you just say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
レイ様……
今、
なんて言いました？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose...
text_block_list.orig_text: 負けていられないって……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, let's start preparing for next year from now on! Did I mention that I've been thinking of various Halloween costumes for you, Miss Rei?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら今から来年の準備をしましょう！
私、
レイ様のハロウィン衣装を何通りも考えてるって言いましたよね？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah. You said it, right? 
But it's not just limited to Halloween for me, 
I mean, in a broader sense...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ。
言っていたね。
でも私は別に
ハロウィンに限ったことじゃなくて、
なんていうか、
もっと広い意味で……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: The costumes range from mischievous mummy girl to wolf girl, and even fireballs. It's a wide selection!
text_block_list.orig_text:
衣装は小悪魔
ミイラ女
オオカミ女
はては火の玉まで、
より取り見取りですよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Isn't it all of Matthew and the others...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
全部
マシューさんたちじゃないッスか……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Well, Tsugumi is lonely after all. 
If that's the case, maybe I shouldn't wear it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりツムギもさみしいんだね。
そういうことなら
着ないことも……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes!! We did it!! The strategy was a success, Miss Rei!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！！　
作戦勝ちですね！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: It's not like it's impossible, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なくも
ない、
かな。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean by that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
それはどういう……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Is it because I won't wear it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
着ないって
ことっスよね？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Oh noooo~!! Please, Miss Rei~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなぁぁぁ～！！　
お願いしますよ、
レイ様ぁ〜！！
